QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] Gathering Scattered Memories 1
QuestInfo.0: Bringing the scattered memories back to the tree should make everybody happy. But the memories were snatched up by the strong Erdas outside the town. The townspeople aren't strong enough to do anything about it... They need help from someone strong.
QuestInfo.1: You agree to bring Chief Legato 5 Happy Memories from Happy Erdas.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Chief Legato 5 Happy Memories from Happy Erdas.

0.0: Will you help us restore the Tree of Memory?

yes.0: There were four types of memories hanging from the Tree of Memory. Happy, Raging, Sad, and Joyful memories... You must recover these four types. Gather them in that order, and bring them to me.
yes.1: The Happy Memories are located the closest. Please recover them from the Happy Erdas in the Weathered Land of Happiness.
yes.2: There were 50 Happy Memories hanging on the Tree of Memory. Be careful.

no.0: You are the only one who can recover our memories from those powerful Erdas.

1.0: You have recovered all of the Happy Memories that once hung on the Tree of Memory. I recall these were the first to scatter... Now, please return them to the tree...

yes.0: Ah. The Happy Memories have returned to their proper places, thanks to you. Please recover the rest of the memories too.

default.0: Bring me Happy Memories from the Happy Erdas in the Weathered Land of Happiness.
